gloss: to cut into pieces, to carve up

definitions.gloss: to cut into pieces, to carve up, to slice and divide
definitions.explanation: To cut something into portions for distribution or serving. Often used for food but also applicable to abstract concepts like isolating problems.

examples.japanese: ケーキを{切|き}り{分|わ}ける。
ローストビーフを{人数分|にんずうぶん}に{切|き}り{分|わ}けた。
examples.english: I carved the roast beef into portions for everyone.

examples.japanese: {問題|もんだい}を{細|こま}かく{切|き}り{分|わ}けて{一|ひと}つずつ{対処|たいしょ}する。
examples.english: Break the problem down into smaller parts and address each one.

notes:
A compound verb from {切|き}る (to cut) + {分|わ}ける (to divide/separate). The combination emphasizes both cutting and distributing into portions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・ケーキを{切|き}り{分|わ}ける (cut a cake into slices)
・{肉|にく}を{切|き}り{分|わ}ける (carve meat)
・{均等|きんとう}に{切|き}り{分|わ}ける (cut into equal portions)
